integrity: The asymptotic theorem is analytically proved and separately finite-checked; finite verification does not establish asymptotics. Primary comparisons are self-review scholarly assessments, not independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform single-agent S5 partitions and iid uniform atomic valuation colors only. The exact coefficient formula is already represented by classical simple-hypergraph enumeration; its existence is not asserted to be new. Novelty claims concern the bisimulation-specific sharp n log n threshold and Poisson law; equivalent earlier probabilistic formulations may exist.
title: Sharp birthday window for bisimulation-minimal random finite S5 models
